Taylor: quick flag from onboarding run: new v3 reranker (base+quant-int4) shows +5% MRR but NDCG@10 falls ~3.1% on eval-canonical. weird because we calibrated on web-crawl sample.
Ravi: did you use the same tokenization pipeline for calibration as eval?
Taylor: nope. calibrate_corpus -> ./scripts/sample_corpus --source=web-crawl --tok=legacy
 but production eval harness uses tok=canonical_normalizer.
Sasha: that mismatch can bite PTQ hard. quant moments see different activation ranges when tokens differ -> embedding indices shift. run calibration with the exact eval preprocessing.
Taylor: running three runs now: (1) FP32 baseline w/canonical tok, (2) int4 calibrated on legacy web, (3) int4 recalibrated on canonical. command I used: 
```
./rerank_eval --model=rerank-v3 --mode=offline --holdout=2024-02 --k=10 --preproc=canonical_normalizer
```
metrics snapshot:
```
FP32-canonical:   MRR 0.215 NDCG@10 0.520
INT4-webcalib:     MRR 0.226 NDCG@10 0.504
INT4-canocalib:   MRR 0.227 NDCG@10 0.517
```
so recalibration recovered most NDCG loss.
Ravi: nice. what's CI on the ndcg delta?
Taylor: bootstrap 10k: INT4-canocalib vs FP32: delta -0.003, 95% CI [-0.010, +0.004] -> not significant. INT4-webcalib vs FP32: delta -0.016, 95% CI [-0.024, -0.008].
QA-bot: note: eval-canonical holdout includes heavy multi-doc queries. slice stats: queries with >2 rel docs have ndcg sensitivity 3x vs single-rel queries.
Sasha: can you produce per-query histograms of score changes and a topk-swap heatmap? helps human review.
Taylor: attaching quick ascii table of top1 swap rate by query_len: 
```
len<6: top1_swap 2.1%
6<=len<12: top1_swap 4.9%
len>=12: top1_swap 9.8%
```
Longer queries showing more volatility -> explains ndcg hit (more relevant items).
Ravi: also check candidate candidate-dup normalization: web sample had HTML fragments so tokenization produced extra stop tokens that canonical removes. that changes scoring priors.
Taylor: did a manual inspect of 30 queries with ndcg drop >0.05. found many cases where boilerplate html tokens were stripped by canonical tok, shifting anchors. couple examples pasted: 
Taylor: "query: migrate postgres to gcp" -> doc A used to contain "<code>pg_dump  --  " and legacy tok kept spaces -> model favored A; canonical collapsed -> model score down.
Sasha: ok action items: 1) always calibrate on corpus processed by production preproc, 2) add a regression check in eval harness that compares int-run calibrations vs fp32 on canonical, fail if ndcg delta < -0.02 on long-query slice, 3) add a preproc parity unit to CI.
Taylor: implemented a fast-check script: ./tools/check_calib_parity --model=rerank-v3 --calib-corpora=web,canonical -> exits non-zero if delta<-0.02 on slice. pushing PR.
infra-bot: CI triggered for PR #4123 (Taylor) -> build passed, eval job queued.
Ravi: for canary, recommend 5% traffic with score logging + per-query diff hist + human review panel for 100 failing queries.
Taylor: scheduled canary today 10:30 PT. will monitor NDGC/MRR, p99 latency, error rates.
QA-bot: also include embedding norm drift monitor: quant can change embedding magnitude distribution causing ranking tie behavior.
Sasha: good catch. add alert if median embedding norm drift >5% vs baseline.
Taylor: thanks all. recap: root cause = calibration corpus mismatch + preproc differences; fix = recalibrate on production preproc + harness checks. will update when canary completes. :rocket:
